s: [n] puM, (trIRi BUrAdIni sattvAdIni vA DAmAni sTAnAni yasya .) vizRuH । (yaTA, mukundamAlAyAm । 11 । “tfzRAtoye madanapavanodDUtamohormimAle dArAvartte sahajatanayagrAhasaNGAkule ca । saMsArAKye mahati jalaDO majjatAM nastriDAman ! pAdAmBoje varada ! Bavato BaktinAve prasIda ॥”) SivaH । agniH । mftyuH । iti SabdArTakalpataruH ॥ (daSamadvAparasya vyAsaH । yaTA, devIBAgavate । 1 । 3 । 28 । “svArasvatastu navame triDAmA daSame taTA ॥”) DAmatraye, klI strI ca ॥ (klI, svargaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 3 । 24 । 20 । “haMso haMsena yAnena triDAma paramaM yayO ॥” “triDAma tftIyaM DAma svargaH tasya parAM kAzWAM satyalokam ॥” iti tawwIkAyAM svAmI ॥)

m: त्रि—धा—मूर्ति f. a girl 3 years of age representing Durgā at her festivals.

v: pu॰ trIRi DAmAni BUrAdIni sTAnAni, tejAMsi sattvAdIni vA yasya । 1 Sive, 2 vizRO, 3 agnO ca । SabdArTakalpataruH । samAhAradviguH । 4 DAmatraye na॰ strI strItvapakze vA NIp । “sa evoktaScakramidaM trinABisaptASvayuktaM vahate vE triDAma” BA॰ Anu॰ 158 a॰ । “triDAmAnaM japaMstatra smaran vizRuM sanAtanam” harivaM॰ 271 a॰ । 6 ta॰ । 5 trisaMKyAnvite tri॰ tAti ca katicit saMkzipya “triguRIkftasarvANgI cidrUpA SivagehinI । prasUte” ityupakrame “tripuzkaraM svarAn devIrbrahmAdInAM trayaM trayam । vahnikAlatrayaM SaktitrayaM vfttitrayaM mahat । nAqItrayaM trivargaM sA yadyadanyat triDAma tat” SA॰ ti॰ uktAni । anyAnyapi tritvasaMKyAnvitAni ekAdiSabde dfSyAni ।
m: त्रि—धामन् mfn. shining in the 3 worlds, 8, 31; VP. ii, 8, 54 (‘triple-gloried’)
त्रि—धामन् m. Viṣṇu, xii; Hariv.; R. vii; BhP. vi
N. of the Vyāsa (= Viṣṇu) of the 10th Dvāpara, VP. iii, 3, 13; VāyuP. i, 23, 136; DevībhP. i, 3; KūrmaP. i, 52, 4.

the aggregate of the 3 minerals or of the 3 humours, W.
